verses.original: שִׁמְע֞וּ אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֜י נֹשֵׂ֧א עֲלֵיכֶ֛ם קִינָ֖ה בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî nō·śê ‘ă·lê·ḵem qî·nāh bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Hear this word O house of Israel this lamentation I take up against you
verses.literalPt: Ouvi esta palavra que levanto com pranto sobre vós, ó casa de Israel:

verses.original: נָֽפְלָה֙ לֹֽא־ תוֹסִ֣יף ק֔וּם בְּתוּלַ֖ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל נִטְּשָׁ֥ה עַל־ אַדְמָתָ֖הּ אֵ֥ין מְקִימָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: nā·p̄ə·lāh lō- ṯō·w·sîp̄ qūm bə·ṯū·laṯ yiś·rā·’êl niṭ·ṭə·šāh ‘al- ’aḏ·mā·ṯāh ’ên mə·qî·māh
verses.literal: Fallen is Virgin Israel never to rise again She lies abandoned on her land with no one to raise her up
verses.literalPt: Caiu a virgem de Israel; não se levantará mais; atirada está sobre a sua terra; não há quem a levante.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה הָעִ֛יר הַיֹּצֵ֥את אֶ֖לֶף תַּשְׁאִ֣יר מֵאָ֑ה וְהַיּוֹצֵ֥את מֵאָ֛ה תַּשְׁאִ֥יר עֲשָׂרָ֖ה לְבֵ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hā·‘îr hay·yō·ṣêṯ ’e·lep̄ taš·’îr mê·’āh wə·hay·yō·w·ṣêṯ mê·’āh taš·’îr ‘ă·śā·rāh lə·ḇêṯ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: This is what . . . the Lord GOD says The city that marches out a thousand strong will have but a hundred left and the one that marches out a hundred strong will have but ten left in the house of Israel
verses.literalPt: Pois assim diz o Senhor Jeová: A cidade que saiu à guerra em número de mil terá de resto cem, e a que saiu em número de cem terá dez, para a casa de Israel.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֖ה לְבֵ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל דִּרְשׁ֖וּנִי וִֽחְיֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh lə·ḇêṯ yiś·rā·’êl dir·šū·nî wiḥ·yū
verses.literal: For this is what the LORD says to the house of Israel Seek Me and live
verses.literalPt: Pois assim diz Jeová à casa de Israel: Buscai-me e vivereis;

verses.original: וְאַֽל־ תִּדְרְשׁוּ֙ בֵּֽית־ אֵ֔ל וְהַגִּלְגָּל֙ לֹ֣א תָבֹ֔אוּ וּבְאֵ֥ר שֶׁ֖בַע לֹ֣א תַעֲבֹ֑רוּ כִּ֤י הַגִּלְגָּל֙ גָּלֹ֣ה יִגְלֶ֔ה וּבֵֽית־ אֵ֖ל יִהְיֶ֥ה לְאָֽוֶן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’al- tiḏ·rə·šū bêṯ- ’êl wə·hag·gil·gāl lō ṯā·ḇō·’ū ū·ḇə·’êr še·ḇa‘ lō ṯa·‘ă·ḇō·rū kî hag·gil·gāl gā·lōh yiḡ·leh ū·ḇêṯ- ’êl yih·yeh lə·’ā·wen
verses.literal: Do not seek Bethel or go to Gilgal do not journey to Beersheba . . . for Gilgal will surely go into exile . . . and Bethel will come to nothing
verses.literalPt: não busqueis, porém, a Betel, nem entreis em Gilgal, nem passeis a Berseba, porque Gilgal, certamente, irá ao cativeiro, e Betel ficará reduzida a nada.

verses.original: דִּרְשׁ֥וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה וִֽחְי֑וּ פֶּן־ יִצְלַ֤ח כָּאֵשׁ֙ בֵּ֣ית יוֹסֵ֔ף וְאָכְלָ֥ה וְאֵין־ מְכַבֶּ֖ה לְבֵֽית־ אֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: dir·šū ’eṯ- Yah·weh wiḥ·yū pen- yiṣ·laḥ kā·’êš bêṯ yō·w·sêp̄ wə·’ā·ḵə·lāh wə·’ên- mə·ḵab·beh lə·ḇêṯ- ’êl
verses.literal: Seek the LORD and live or He will sweep like fire through the house of Joseph it will devour everything with no one at Bethel to extinguish it
verses.literalPt: Buscai a Jeová e vivereis, para que ele não irrompa como fogo na casa de José, e o fogo devore, e não haja quem o apague em Betel.

verses.original: הַהֹפְכִ֥ים לְלַעֲנָ֖ה מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּצְדָקָ֖ה לָאָ֥רֶץ הִנִּֽיחוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ha·hō·p̄ə·ḵîm lə·la·‘ă·nāh miš·pāṭ ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh lā·’ā·reṣ hin·nî·ḥū
verses.literal: There are those who turn justice into wormwood and cast righteousness to the ground
verses.literalPt: Vós que converteis o juízo em absinto e lançais por terra a justiça,

verses.original: עֹשֵׂ֨ה כִימָ֜ה וּכְסִ֗יל וְהֹפֵ֤ךְ לַבֹּ֙קֶר֙ צַלְמָ֔וֶת וְי֖וֹם לַ֣יְלָה הֶחְשִׁ֑יךְ הַקּוֹרֵ֣א לְמֵֽי־ הַיָּ֗ם וַֽיִּשְׁפְּכֵ֛ם עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ יְהוָ֥ה שְׁמֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·śêh ḵî·māh ū·ḵə·sîl wə·hō·p̄êḵ lab·bō·qer ṣal·mā·weṯ wə·yō·wm lay·lāh heḥ·šîḵ haq·qō·w·rê lə·mê- hay·yām way·yiš·pə·ḵêm ‘al- pə·nê hā·’ā·reṣ Yah·weh šə·mōw
verses.literal: He who made the Pleiades and Orion who turns darkness into dawn and darkens day into night who summons the waters of the sea and pours them over the face of the earth the LORD is His name
verses.literalPt: buscai aquele que faz as Plêiades e Órion, e que troca em manhã a sombra da morte, e com as trevas transforma o dia em noite; o que chama as águas do mar e as derrama sobre a face da terra; Jeová é o seu nome.

verses.original: הַמַּבְלִ֥יג שֹׁ֖ד עַל־ עָ֑ז וְשֹׁ֖ד עַל־ מִבְצָ֥ר יָבֽוֹא׃
verses.transliteration: ham·maḇ·lîḡ šōḏ ‘al- ‘āz wə·šōḏ ‘al- miḇ·ṣār yā·ḇō·w
verses.literal: He flashes destruction on the strong so that fury comes upon the stronghold
verses.literalPt: Ele é o que faz cair repentina destruição sobre o forte, de sorte que venha a destruição sobre a fortaleza.

verses.original: שָׂנְא֥וּ בַשַּׁ֖עַר מוֹכִ֑יחַ וְדֹבֵ֥ר תָּמִ֖ים יְתָעֵֽבוּ׃
verses.transliteration: śā·nə·’ū ḇaš·ša·‘ar mō·w·ḵî·aḥ wə·ḏō·ḇêr tā·mîm yə·ṯā·‘ê·ḇū
verses.literal: There are those who hate the one who reproves in the gate and despise him who speaks with integrity
verses.literalPt: Aborrecem ao que na porta usa de repreensões e abominam o que fala sinceramente.

verses.original: לָ֠כֵן יַ֣עַן בּוֹשַׁסְכֶ֞ם עַל־ דָּ֗ל וּמַשְׂאַת־ בַּר֙ תִּקְח֣וּ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ בָּתֵּ֥י גָזִ֛ית בְּנִיתֶ֖ם וְלֹא־ תֵ֣שְׁבוּ בָ֑ם כַּרְמֵי־ חֶ֣מֶד נְטַעְתֶּ֔ם וְלֹ֥א תִשְׁתּ֖וּ אֶת־ יֵינָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ya·‘an bō·wō·šas·ḵem ‘al- dāl ū·maś·’aṯ- bar tiq·ḥū mim·men·nū bāt·tê ḡā·zîṯ bə·nî·ṯem wə·lō- ṯê·šə·ḇū ḇām kar·mê- ḥe·meḏ nə·ṭa‘·tem wə·lō ṯiš·tū ’eṯ- yê·nām
verses.literal: Therefore because you trample on the poor and exact from him a tax of grain you will never live in the stone houses . . . you have built you will never drink the wine from the lush vineyards you have planted
verses.literalPt: Por isso, porque pisais aos pés o pobre e dele recebeis exações de trigo, tendes edificado casas de pedras lavradas, porém nelas não habitareis; tendes plantado vinhas deliciosas, porém não bebereis do vinho delas.

verses.original: כִּ֤י יָדַ֙עְתִּי֙ רַבִּ֣ים פִּשְׁעֵיכֶ֔ם וַעֲצֻמִ֖ים חַטֹּֽאתֵיכֶ֑ם צֹרְרֵ֤י צַדִּיק֙ לֹ֣קְחֵי כֹ֔פֶר וְאֶבְיוֹנִ֖ים בַּשַּׁ֥עַר הִטּֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî yā·ḏa‘·tî rab·bîm piš·‘ê·ḵem wa·‘ă·ṣu·mîm ḥaṭ·ṭō·ṯê·ḵem ṣō·rə·rê ṣad·dîq lō·qə·ḥê ḵō·p̄er wə·’eḇ·yō·w·nîm baš·ša·‘ar hiṭ·ṭū
verses.literal: For I know that your transgressions are many and your sins are numerous You oppress the righteous by taking bribes you deprive the poor of justice in the gate
verses.literalPt: Pois sei quão numerosas são as vossas transgressões e quão grandes, os vossos pecados, vós que afligis o justo, que aceitais peitas, e que na porta rejeitais o necessitado.

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן הַמַּשְׂכִּ֛יל בָּעֵ֥ת הַהִ֖יא יִדֹּ֑ם כִּ֛י עֵ֥ת רָעָ֖ה הִֽיא׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ham·maś·kîl bā·‘êṯ ha·hî yid·dōm kî ‘êṯ rā·‘āh hî
verses.literal: Therefore the prudent keep silent in such times for the days are evil . . .
verses.literalPt: Portanto, o prudente se calará naquele tempo, porque é tempo mau.

verses.original: דִּרְשׁוּ־ ט֥וֹב וְאַל־ רָ֖ע לְמַ֣עַן תִּֽחְי֑וּ וִיהִי־ כֵ֞ן יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־ צְבָא֛וֹת אִתְּכֶ֖ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲמַרְתֶּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: dir·šū- ṭō·wḇ wə·’al- rā‘ lə·ma·‘an tiḥ·yū wî·hî- ḵên Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê- ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’it·tə·ḵem ka·’ă·šer ’ă·mar·tem
verses.literal: Seek good not evil so that you may live And the LORD the God of Hosts will be . . . with you as you have claimed
verses.literalPt: Buscai o bem e não o mal, para que vivais; e assim Jeová, Deus dos Exércitos, será convosco, como dizeis.

verses.original: שִׂנְאוּ־ רָע֙ וְאֶ֣הֱבוּ ט֔וֹב וְהַצִּ֥יגוּ בַשַּׁ֖עַר מִשְׁפָּ֑ט אוּלַ֗י יֶֽחֱנַ֛ן יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־ צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁאֵרִ֥ית יוֹסֵֽף׃ס
verses.transliteration: śin·’ū- rā‘ wə·’e·hĕ·ḇū ṭō·wḇ wə·haṣ·ṣî·ḡū ḇaš·ša·‘ar miš·pāṭ ’ū·lay ye·ḥĕ·nan Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê- ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ šə·’ê·rîṯ yō·w·sêp̄
verses.literal: Hate evil and love good establish justice in the gate Perhaps the LORD the God of Hosts will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph
verses.literalPt: Aborrecei o mal, e amai o bem, e estabelecei na porta o juízo. Pode ser que Jeová, Deus dos Exércitos, se compadeça do resto de José.

verses.original: לָ֠כֵן כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י צְבָאוֹת֙ אֲדֹנָ֔י בְּכָל־ רְחֹב֣וֹת מִסְפֵּ֔ד וּבְכָל־ חוּצ֖וֹת יֹאמְר֣וּ הוֹ־ ה֑וֹ וְקָרְא֤וּ אִכָּר֙ אֶל־ אֵ֔בֶל וּמִסְפֵּ֖ד אֶל־ י֥וֹדְעֵי נֶֽהִי׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ă·ḏō·nāy bə·ḵāl rə·ḥō·ḇō·wṯ mis·pêḏ ū·ḇə·ḵāl ḥū·ṣō·wṯ yō·mə·rū hōw- hōw wə·qā·rə·’ū ’ik·kār ’el- ’ê·ḇel ū·mis·pêḏ ’el- yō·wḏ·‘ê ne·hî
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the LORD the God of Hosts the Lord says There will be wailing in all the public squares and cries of Alas Alas in all the streets The farmer will be summoned to mourn and the mourners . . . to wail
verses.literalPt: Portanto, assim diz Jeová, Deus dos Exércitos, o Senhor: Em todas as praças haverá pranto; e em todas as ruas dirão: Ai! Ai! Eles chamarão o lavrador para o pranto e, para o choro, os que sabem carpir.

verses.original: וּבְכָל־ כְּרָמִ֖ים מִסְפֵּ֑ד כִּֽי־ אֶעֱבֹ֥ר בְּקִרְבְּךָ֖ אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·ḵāl kə·rā·mîm mis·pêḏ kî- ’e·‘ĕ·ḇōr bə·qir·bə·ḵā ’ā·mar Yah·weh
verses.literal: There will be wailing in all the vineyards for I will pass through your midst says the LORD
verses.literalPt: Em todas as vinhas haverá pranto, porque passarei pelo meio de ti, diz Jeová.

verses.original: ה֥וֹי הַמִּתְאַוִּ֖ים אֶת־ י֣וֹם יְהוָ֑ה לָמָּה־ זֶּ֥ה לָכֶ֛ם י֥וֹם יְהוָ֖ה הוּא־ חֹ֥שֶׁךְ וְלֹא־ אֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w ham·miṯ·’aw·wîm ’eṯ- yō·wm Yah·weh lām·māh- zeh lā·ḵem yō·wm Yah·weh hū- ḥō·šeḵ wə·lō- ’ō·wr
verses.literal: Woe to you who long for the Day of the LORD What . . . will the Day of the LORD be for you It will be darkness and not light
verses.literalPt: Ai de vós que desejais o Dia de Jeová! Para que desejais vós o Dia de Jeová? Ele é trevas e não luz.

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יָנ֥וּס אִישׁ֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י הָאֲרִ֔י וּפְגָע֖וֹ הַדֹּ֑ב וּבָ֣א הַבַּ֔יִת וְסָמַ֤ךְ יָדוֹ֙ עַל־ הַקִּ֔יר וּנְשָׁכ֖וֹ הַנָּחָֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer yā·nūs ’îš mip·pə·nê hā·’ă·rî ū·p̄ə·ḡā·‘ōw had·dōḇ ū·ḇā hab·ba·yiṯ wə·sā·maḵ yā·ḏōw ‘al- haq·qîr ū·nə·šā·ḵōw han·nā·ḥāš
verses.literal: It will be like a man who flees from a lion only to encounter a bear or who enters his house and rests his hand against the wall only to be bitten by a snake
verses.literalPt: É como se um homem fugisse de diante dum leão, e lhe saísse ao encontro um urso; ou como se entrasse em casa e encostasse a mão à parede, e o mordesse uma cobra.

verses.original: הֲלֹא־ חֹ֛שֶׁךְ י֥וֹם יְהוָ֖ה וְלֹא־ א֑וֹר וְאָפֵ֖ל וְלֹא־ נֹ֥גַֽהּ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō- ḥō·šeḵ yō·wm Yah·weh wə·lō- ’ō·wr wə·’ā·p̄êl wə·lō- nō·ḡah lōw
verses.literal: Will not the Day of the LORD be darkness and not light even gloom with no brightness in it
verses.literalPt: Acaso, não será o Dia de Jeová trevas e não luz? Sim, bem escuro, sem que haja nele resplendor algum.

verses.original: שָׂנֵ֥אתִי מָאַ֖סְתִּי חַגֵּיכֶ֑ם וְלֹ֥א אָרִ֖יחַ בְּעַצְּרֹֽתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: śā·nê·ṯî mā·’as·tî ḥag·gê·ḵem wə·lō ’ā·rî·aḥ bə·‘aṣ·ṣə·rō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: I hate I despise your feasts I cannot stand the stench of your solemn assemblies
verses.literalPt: Aborreço, desprezo as vossas festas e não me deleitarei nas vossas assembleias solenes.

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם־ תַּעֲלוּ־ לִ֥י עֹל֛וֹת וּמִנְחֹתֵיכֶ֖ם לֹ֣א אֶרְצֶ֑ה וְשֶׁ֥לֶם מְרִיאֵיכֶ֖ם לֹ֥א אַבִּֽיט׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- ta·‘ă·lū- lî ‘ō·lō·wṯ ū·min·ḥō·ṯê·ḵem lō ’er·ṣeh wə·še·lem mə·rî·’ê·ḵem lō ’ab·bîṭ
verses.literal: Even though you offer Me burnt offerings and grain offerings I will not accept them for your peace offerings of fattened cattle I will have no regard
verses.literalPt: Pois, ainda que me ofereçais os vossos holocaustos e as vossas ofertas de cereais, não os aceitarei, nem atentarei para as ofertas pacíficas dos vossos animais cevados.

verses.original: הָסֵ֥ר מֵעָלַ֖י הֲמ֣וֹן שִׁרֶ֑יךָ וְזִמְרַ֥ת נְבָלֶ֖יךָ לֹ֥א אֶשְׁמָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: hā·sêr mê·‘ā·lay hă·mō·wn ši·re·ḵā wə·zim·raṯ nə·ḇā·le·ḵā lō ’eš·mā‘
verses.literal: Take away from Me the noise of your songs I will not listen to the music of your harps
verses.literalPt: Aparta de mim o estrépito dos teus cânticos, porque não ouvirei a melodia das tuas liras.

verses.original: וְיִגַּ֥ל כַּמַּ֖יִם מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּצְדָקָ֖ה כְּנַ֥חַל אֵיתָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yig·gal kam·ma·yim miš·pāṭ ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh kə·na·ḥal ’ê·ṯān
verses.literal: But let justice roll on like a river and righteousness like an ever-flowing stream
verses.literalPt: Porém desça o juízo como águas, e a justiça, como uma torrente poderosa.

verses.original: הַזְּבָחִ֨ים וּמִנְחָ֜ה הִֽגַּשְׁתֶּם־ לִ֧י בַמִּדְבָּ֛ר אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: haz·zə·ḇā·ḥîm ū·min·ḥāh hig·gaš·tem- lî ḇam·miḏ·bār ’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Did you bring Me sacrifices and offerings forty years in the wilderness O house of Israel
verses.literalPt: Porventura, ó casa de Israel, oferecestes-me sacrifícios e ofertas no deserto durante quarenta anos?

verses.original: וּנְשָׂאתֶ֗ם אֵ֚ת סִכּ֣וּת מַלְכְּכֶ֔ם וְאֵ֖ת כִּיּ֣וּן צַלְמֵיכֶ֑ם כּוֹכַב֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·nə·śā·ṯem ’êṯ sik·kūṯ mal·kə·ḵem wə·’êṯ kî·yūn ṣal·mê·ḵem kō·w·ḵaḇ ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem ’ă·šer ‘ă·śî·ṯem lā·ḵem
verses.literal: You have taken along Sakkuth your king and Kaiwan your star god the idols you made for yourselves
verses.literalPt: Sim, levastes Sicute, vosso rei, e Quium, vossas imagens, a estrela do vosso deus, que fizestes para vós.

verses.original: וְהִגְלֵיתִ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם מֵהָ֣לְאָה לְדַמָּ֑שֶׂק אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־ צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hiḡ·lê·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem mê·hā·lə·’āh lə·ḏam·mā·śeq ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê- ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ šə·mōw
verses.literal: Therefore I will send you into exile beyond Damascus says the LORD whose name is the God of Hosts
verses.literalPt: Portanto, vos levarei cativos para além de Damasco, diz Jeová, cujo nome é o Deus dos Exércitos.
